answer: Andy Burnham is the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. He assumed office on July 20, 2026, succeeding Keir Starmer. Burnham, who was previously serving as mayor of Greater Manchester, became the leader of the Labour Party and is the country's seventh Prime Minister in 10 years.
